The '''warru'zan''', the bloodhalls, was a location on the [[planet]] [[Kalee]]. At some point, the [[Kaleesh]] [[Elder (title)|elders]] had indoctrinated [[Sidon Ithano|Sidon]], later known as the [[Delphidian]] [[pirate]] Sidon Ithano.<ref name="Sinister Secret of the Binary Star" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The warru'zan was first mentioned in the [[2025]] short story "[[Galactic Tales: The Crimson Corsair and the Sinister Secret of the Binary Star]]," written by [[Landry Q. Walker]].<ref name= "Sinister Secret of the Binary Star" />
